name: save-boot-12c-dialog-world-circle
description: #108 attempt 1 (acceptance candidate: dialogWaiting drops after Circle, the window closes). As save-boot-12b up to window 0 in state 6, then one Circle (4 frames): wait until the state leaves 6 (left_wait), 30 frames, report the state (win0_after); then Circle every 60 frames until the state reads 0 (close_wait). Checks the window is closed (closed), still in the world map, and that a rerun matches. #140 needed three Circle presses to close it; this shows whether that is several pages.
